verdict.rationale: Kong Gateway's architecture is Admin-API-first, with Kong Manager UI and decK/kongctl CLIs built on top of the same Admin API/declarative config (kong-gh-10, kong-gh-11, kong-docs-4, kong-docs-68), meaning nearly everything configurable is exposed programmatically, and there's an OpenAPI spec directory for Kong APIs (kong-docs-9). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that 100% of Kong Manager or Konnect UI actions have no API-only gaps, and the probe found no working openapi.json at the expected path, weakening self-service API discoverability.
